text:
Sean Monahan has one goal in 18 games for Columbus and none in his last 17, and he missed close to two weeks after playing 10 minutes against Tampa Bay on Nov. 12. He returned Wednesday for 11:24 and picked up an assist. The setup work has stayed steady through the drought: 7 assists, 3 of his 8 points on the power play. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 9.1 primary shot assists per 60 last season, 89th percentile among forwards.

Our numbers say the scoring will turn. He has 1 goal on 3.6 expected goals, and shooting 5.6% sits well below his usual range. The real worry is elsewhere. Evolving-Hockey had his team creating 0.22 more expected goals per 60 with him on the ice in 2025-26 (92nd percentile), but this season the Blue Jackets get only 43% of the 5-on-5 chance quality with him out there. The 2024-25 Masterton winner projects for about 11 goals; watch whether his minutes climb back now that he's healthy.
headline: Sean Monahan's goals have gone missing, not his chances
